reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Matteo Franceschetti, the founder and CEO of Eight Sleep, a smart mattress company.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Matteo Franceschetti, the founder and CEO of Eight Sleep, a smart mattress company. I’m a customer of Eight Sleep and this was one of the most unique founder conversations I’ve had on the show. We talk about which biometrics matter, how hard it is to start a hardware company and launch manufacturing overseas, how Matteo manages his own sleep.
